newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cloncurry, Majestic in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cloncurry, Majestic in merger talks.

text.p: Copper and gold explorer Cloncurry Mining NL said on Monday it had entered preliminary discussions with Majestic Resources NL over plans to merge their respective interests in the Cloncurry area of Queensland.

"Significant synergies may be achievable and to this end consideration is being given to appropriate ways that may secure long term benefits to all shareholders," Cloncurry Mining said in a statement.
The company said it was currently undertaking a detailed assessment of Majestic, which was scheduled for completion in mid-September.
